Uniform weak empirical convergence and bounded kernels give a.s./L1 conditional limits. The bounded V-statistic plus unique-population-minimizer envelope yields Global Pair ratio influence 8I_T−(56/5)I_Q; independent exact piecewise polynomial integration confirms centered Gaussian variance 147113/504000. On masses (a,1−2a,a) at 0,1/2,1, direct conditional pair enumeration yields difference a(1−2a)²(1−3a)/(2(1−a)), a strict sign reversal at a=1/3. Sampling CLT is conditional expectation over lottery, not ex-post pair draw.
